original.sql:
-- Single table: 走 c1 索引顺序
SELECT 'single' AS q,
       (-1) <= CAST((concat(src.c1, '')) && NULL AS SIGNED) AS e
FROM src FORCE INDEX(i_c1)
GROUP BY (-1) <= CAST((concat(src.c1, '')) && NULL AS SIGNED)
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY (-1) <= CAST((concat(src.c1, '')) && NULL AS SIGNED)
LIMIT 3
